cues: Four valves keep the flow one way.
The tricuspid between the right atrium and ventricle; the bicuspid, or mitral, on the left; and two semilunar valves at the exits to the pulmonary artery and the aorta.
Tendon cords anchor the atrioventricular valves, like the strings of a parachute.
